info.title: HookShield control-plane API
info.description: REST API of the HookShield dashboard. Errors always look like {"error":{"code":"…"}} with stable, translatable codes. Narrative guide: docs/API.md. Every operation declares `x-access` (public, read, operate, admin, session); a test keeps this document in sync with the routes the server registers.

get.description: Served by every service (api, ingest, worker).

get.summary: Live feed of log events (Server-Sent Events)

200.description: text/event-stream with events log.created and log.updated (data = JSON without payloads); ': ping' every 15 s

get.description: Use EventSource with withCredentials: true. Session or any API key.

post.summary: Create an API key (the key is shown once)

sessionCookie.name: hs_session
sessionCookie.description: Dashboard session (set by register, login and Google sign-in). State-changing requests also need an allowed Origin header (CSRF).

apiKey.description: API key hs_live_…; scopes read_only, ingest, admin (see x-access).

Unauthorized.description: No valid session or API key (auth.unauthorized, auth.invalid_credentials)

NotFound.description: Not found — also for resources of other accounts

Conflict.description: e.g. auth.email_taken, endpoint.slug_taken, endpoint.no_secret_to_rotate, endpoint.paused, log.key_unavailable

Invalid.description: Validation error; some codes include details

interval.description: How often the plan is billed; quotas are monthly either way

yearly_price_cents.description: Price of a year paid at once; 0 = not sold yearly

TransformRules.description: Declarative transform rules (docs/TRANSFORM.md); {} when the endpoint has none

token_prefix.description: Visible prefix of the current token (token mode)

EndpointInput.description: POST: name and target_url required. PATCH: only the fields sent change.

GeneratedSecrets.description: Present only when a secret was generated in this response

reference.description: Text to paste in a header: {{secrets.NAME}}

ChannelTarget.description: Fields depend on the channel type. Responses are masked.

RenderedBody.description: Exactly one of body (JSON), body_text (UTF-8) or body_base64 (binary)
